verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents DKIM/SPF authentication and DMARC policies, refers to setting up a DKIM DNS record for a custom domain, and its MCP server can manage domains and troubleshoot DNS. A community report confirms a DNS validation dashboard exists, though it flagged unresolved problems without giving details. missing for 10: evidence that Mailgun generates the exact SPF/DKIM/DMARC record values, documentation of an API endpoint exposing domain verification status, detail on the verification workflow, and independent corroboration that verification diagnostics are actionable.
